verdict.rationale: The published pages say Webfile, the core online filing flow, is reached only after you register and log into eSystems. The probe confirms the Webfile transaction surface exists only behind an authenticated session, with no documented keyless or file-number entry. The keyless open-data SODA rail is read-only and is not the core filing flow, and no-sales phone filing is not an online path, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
